summary: Iter38 pre-go-live REAL TEST RUN of IslandHop core marketplace loops. Backend pytest: 11/11 passing. Frontend: driver go-live toggle works (button flips Go Online -> Go Offline, offline banner clears), driver earnings page shows REAL data ($0/$0/$0/0 for a fresh driver + 'No deliveries yet' empty state, no demo names/amounts), Admin Approvals shows 23 Link & provision buttons with correct data-testid on all VERIFIED merchant records.

issues: Go Online / Go Offline toggle button lacks a stable data-testid. Currently only distinguishable by button text — brittle for automation. Recommend adding data-testid="driver-online-toggle".
Location consent modal auto-appears on first visit and can intercept clicks on the toggle. get_by_role() blocked by overlay; direct query_selector still works but tests must handle the modal.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add data-testid="driver-online-toggle" to the Go Online / Go Offline button on DriverDashboard.js for reliable UI testing.

(Nice-to-have) When a driver logs into DriverDashboard, consider deferring the location-consent modal or auto-dismissing behind their first go-online click so it doesn't block the toggle for scripted flows.
None of the tested flows have blocking bugs — app is green for the listed go-live features.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still >10.8k lines; keep migrating admin, driver, and merchant endpoints into routers/ (admin_records.py already exists, follow that pattern).
_resolve_vendor_for_user self-heal correctly matches by user_id only (no email-based takeover surface) — good.
Order.total is currently client-supplied then recomputed server-side in calculate_order_financials — consider fully ignoring client's `total` to make tampering impossible.
PLATFORM_SERVICE_FEE is env-configurable (good) and stamped 100% server-side on every order (verified $3.00).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 primary flows tested (driver toggle, earnings real-data, admin link-provision UI)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review-request bullets verified: (1) driver go-live PUT /api/drivers/status with JSON body {status:...} returns 200 online/offline (backend + UI), (2) DriverEarningsDashboard now uses real data + earnings-empty testid + no John Doe/$15,678 strings, (3) POST /api/orders applies $3 service_fee and correct total, (4) merchant storefront + first product both work (200), (5) approved-merchant self-heal via GET /api/merchant/storefront promotes user_type customer -> business and provisions vendor (verified in DB), (6) admin link-provision returns success+vendor_type and 403 for non-admin; UI shows record-link-provision-{id} on all verified merchant records. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_pregolive.py is the regression suite for this pre-go-live surface.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Design nits only (missing data-testid on driver online toggle, location consent modal can intercept). The four fixes described in the review request — body-vs-query on drivers/status, real earnings, backfill+self-heal for approved merchants, admin link-provision — all verified end-to-end.
